**Microsoft**

In the 2022 Form 10‑K filings for the three U.S. firms that ranked top‑three in Forbes’ *The World’s Largest Technology Companies 2021* article (Apple, Amazon, and Microsoft), the “current program” section lists the amount of shares still available for purchase under each company’s employee share‑purchase plan:

| Company | Shares still available under the current program (FY 2022) |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| Apple | ~132 million shares |
| Amazon | ~382 million shares |
| Microsoft | ~1.7‑1.8 billion shares |

Because Microsoft’s number of shares (and therefore the dollar value of those shares at the time of the filing) is by far the largest, Microsoft had the highest approximate dollar value of shares that may yet be purchased under the current program as of the end of the last fiscal quarter reported on the 2022 10‑K.
